title: finance-dashboard
text:
Shipped, end to end.

fin.atemkeng.com is aliased to deployment dpl_CRbLdDi, state READY, target production. The domain returns 307 to /auth/login for an anonymous request, which is clerkMiddleware behaving correctly.

The vulnerability is closed in production. Both halves now match: Convex rejects a delete whose userId doesn't own the record, and the frontend passes userId from the server-side Clerk session. The temporary broken-delete window from the backend-first step is over.

I verified the deployment is live and correctly aliased. I have not signed in and exercised a real delete, so the fix is verified by deployed function signature and by reading, not by an end-to-end run. If you want certainty, deleting one of your own foreign income rows in the UI is the check.

Three loose ends, in the order I'd deal with them:

.env.production.pull is untracked but not gitignored, and holds CLERKSECRETKEY. One git add . commits a secret to a public repo. A one-line .gitignore addition fixes it.

Your checklist work is still in stash@{0}, and you're on main:

The outer fin-expenses repo is still the mess from earlier: 15,450 tracked .venv files, a one-line uncommitted .gitignore, and .env holding CONVEXDEPLOYKEY sitting untracked and unignored.

Want me to take the gitignore hygiene now? It's small, and it's the same class of problem that just made me pause before deploying.
